notes: Stage S1 (pilot) of the RQ-H1B resource decision; the record is validation/review-quality/resource-decision.md.
Measured with the production renderer at context 10000: 10 cases render to 28514 chat input tokens and 29424 decision input tokens; the largest single request is 3059.
Total planned input is 2 x 28514 + 5 x 29424 = 204148 estimated input tokens over the 70 sendable cells.
The grid is 10 cases x 7 targets x 2 protocols x 1 repeat = 140 cells. Each target offers exactly one protocol, so 70 are supported and 70 are recorded unsupported without a request.

bounds.maxAttempts 180 is the pilot's hard stop; the worst case the run can actually spend is 90 = 50 decision cells x 1 attempt + 20 chat cells x 2 (one attempt plus the transport's one repair). The 90 attempt headroom is the retry and margin allowance, not a plan to spend it.

Two of the ten cases declare their own material incomplete (2 cases). That is an input fact to measure, not a run failure; no case is truncated at this budget (0 truncated segments), which is why context.maxInputTokens stays at the production default.

This plan is not dispatchable today: the runner refuses a live chat cell without the host LLM service, and it rejects an empty credential reference. Both are recorded as blockers in the resource decision; neither is worked around by inventing a credential.
Targets 3-5 name credential references only. No credential value appears in this document; a live run resolves CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN and TYPESAFE_API_KEY from the environment.

Targets 6-7 are the host's chat routes. provider and model are the host-observed route ids, which differ from the display labels; they must be re-confirmed with listProviders/listModels before dispatch.
